none: PAS FindID 971894: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of the House of Constantine (306-361), if so, probably a Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Chipped. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them; square vexillum on standard. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 14.3mm, Weight: 0.96gms, die axis: 11
